title: P2.13b Commit authenticated stream resumes atomically
description: Second SPIDR slice of P2.13. Wire the canonical kind into the daemon registry and implement an authenticated, session-bound, durable idempotent command. The command decision receipt and the sanctioned subscription reseat must commit in one SQLite transaction.
definitionOfDone: Verify on disk that task-f46ed0855969407ab2607aa6a4f49354 has made events.resume a generated command entry sourced from RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS; report blocked if absent because a daemon-only kind would create a second vocabulary.

The daemon registry admits exact payload keys presentedCursor, projection, and subscriberId under work.write, and the handler binds subscriberId to the authenticated session principal rather than trusting a foreign session identifier.

The first valid command calls the existing resumeFromSnapshot decision through the transaction database supplied by SqliteEventStore.commitExpectedVersionDecisionWithApply, so cursor reseat and the durable command receipt commit or roll back together without a second cursor authority.

An identical command retry does not reseat again and returns the stored receipt with the same commandId, effectId, and resultCode; reusing its command identity with different request bytes refuses EVENT_STREAM_RESUME_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT at DAEMON_EVENT_STREAM_RESUME.

Malformed admitted payload refuses EVENT_STREAM_RESUME_INPUT_INVALID and a foreign subscriber refuses EVENT_STREAM_RESUME_SESSION_MISMATCH, both at DAEMON_EVENT_STREAM_RESUME; existing outer authentication, capability, and PAYLOAD_SHAPE codes/layers remain unchanged.

Focused daemon tests prove valid mutation, atomic rollback, one reseat across replay, stored-receipt replay, conflict, malformed, and foreign-session arms with exact codes/layers and a nonzero standalone test-count line.
taskRails: Do not route events.resume through dispatchQueryBytes.
Reuse resumeFromSnapshot for cursor/snapshot admission; do not duplicate its presented-cursor checks.
Use the CommitApply transaction database for the subscription write; do not open a second SQLite connection inside the atomic apply.
Replay must read durable result bytes and must never echo the retry candidate.
